spans.s:
n. (-तं)
A hundred texts.
E.
ऋच् a prayer, and शत a century.

f. (-ता)
The collection of the prayers and hymns of the Ṛk Veda.
E.
ऋच् and संहिता compendium.

r. 5th cl. (ऋक्ष्णोति)
To kill, to hurt or seek to hurt.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Pierced, cut, divided.
mn. (-क्षः-क्षं)
A star, a constellation.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A mountain in the peninsula, the temporary residence of

A bear.
3 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
E.
ऋष to go, Uṇādi affix स, the radical final then becomes क, and स becomes ष; and क and ष form the compound letter क्ष.

f. (-न्धा)
1 A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.)
2 Another sort, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)
E.
ऋक्ष a bear, and गन्ध smell, smelling like a bear.

f. (-का)
A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus paniculatus, the pale sort): see the preceding.
E.
as before, कन् added.

n. (-रं)
A shower, a stream.
m. (-रः)
A family priest.
E.
ऋष to go, and सर Uṇādi affix: see the derivation of ऋक्ष.

n. (-नं)
Observing or seeing the stars.
E.
ऋक्ष and विभावन noticing.

m. (-शः)
The moon.
E.
ऋक्ष a star, ईश lord.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Offering worship to the planets and stars.
E.
ऋल and इष्टि worship.
